title: Wiggly's Messy Day
reason: Correct dialogue and replace the unclear score ending with a concrete spatial-awareness strategy supported by the final illustration.

pages.1: Wiggly woke up carefully. "Today I will watch my long tail," he said.
pages.2: Wiggly walked carefully. His tail tipped Chompy's breakfast. "Sorry, Chompy!" he said. He helped clean it up.
pages.3: Wiggly walked even more carefully. His tail bumped Grumpy's favourite rock. "Hmph!" said Grumpy.
pages.4: Wiggly tried again. His tail splashed Fancy into a mud puddle. "Oh no!" said Wiggly.
pages.5: Wiggly sat very still. His tail rolled three berries and one leaf away.
pages.6: Wiggly felt sad. "My tail is hard to watch," he said.
pages.7: "Your tail can help too," Dozy said. "It makes a cool breeze when you move it slowly." The Pals smiled.
pages.8: Wiggly placed bright stones around his tail to show how much room it needed. "Now I can watch my space," he said.
